section: Test of English Language and Comprehension
q_en:
A sentence with a grammatical error is given. Identify the error and then from the given options, select the sentence which is error-free and grammatically correct.
Joseph sailed from the Maldives on Friday and arriving here on Sunday.
q_hi:
A sentence with a grammatical error is given. Identify the error and then from the given options, select the sentence which is error-free and grammatically correct.
Joseph sailed from the Maldives on Friday and arriving here on Sunday.
op_en: Joseph sail from the Maldives on Friday and had arrive here on Sunday.
Joseph sailed from the Maldives on Friday and arrive here on Sunday.
Joseph sailed from the Maldives on Friday and had been arriving here on Sunday.
Joseph sailed from the Maldives on Friday and arrived here on Sunday.
op_hi: Joseph sail from the Maldives on Friday and had arrive here on Sunday.
Joseph sailed from the Maldives on Friday and arrive here on Sunday.
Joseph sailed from the Maldives on Friday and had been arriving here on Sunday.
Joseph sailed from the Maldives on Friday and arrived here on Sunday.
solution:
Solution (EN):
The original sentence has a parallelism error. The verb "sailed" is in the simple past tense, so the conjunction "and" should connect it to another verb in the simple past tense. "arriving" is a present participle, which makes the sentence grammatically incorrect. Therefore, "arrived" is the correct verb form.

Solution (HI):
मूल वाक्य में parallelism (समानांतरता) की त्रुटि है। क्रिया "sailed" simple past tense (सामान्य भूतकाल) में है, इसलिए conjunction "and" को इसे simple past tense के एक अन्य क्रिया से जोड़ना चाहिए। "arriving" एक present participle है, जो वाक्य को व्याकरणिक रूप से गलत बनाता है। इसलिए, "arrived" सही क्रिया रूप है।

Final Answer: Joseph sailed from the Maldives on Friday and arrived here on Sunday.

She worked hardly to complete her thesis before the deadline.
q_hi:
Identify the error in the sentence and select the best correction.

She worked hardly to complete her thesis before the deadline.
op_en: She worked hard to complete her thesis before the deadline.
She worked hardest to complete her thesis before the deadline.
She worked harder to complete her thesis before the deadline.

She worked hardest to complete her thesis before the deadline.
She worked harder to complete her thesis before the deadline.
solution:
Solution (EN):
The word 'hardly' means 'barely' or 'scarcely', which gives a negative meaning to the sentence. The correct adverb to use here is 'hard', which means with a great deal of effort.

Solution (HI):
'Hardly' शब्द का अर्थ है 'मुश्किल से' (barely/scarcely), जो वाक्य को एक नकारात्मक अर्थ देता है। यहाँ उपयोग करने के लिए सही क्रियाविशेषण (adverb) 'hard' है, जिसका अर्थ है बहुत अधिक प्रयास या मेहनत के साथ।

section: Test of English Language and Comprehension
q_en:
Identify the error in the sentence and select the best correction.

The committee have reviews the proposal thoroughly.
q_hi:
Identify the error in the sentence and select the best correction.

The committee have reviews the proposal thoroughly.
op_en: The committee has review the proposal thoroughly.
The committee have review the proposal thoroughly.
The committee having reviewed the proposal thoroughly.
The committee has reviewed the proposal thoroughly.
op_hi: The committee has review the proposal thoroughly.
The committee have review the proposal thoroughly.
The committee having reviewed the proposal thoroughly.
The committee has reviewed the proposal thoroughly.
solution:
Solution (EN):
'Committee' is a collective noun and is generally treated as a singular noun when acting as a single unit, so it takes the singular helping verb 'has'. Also, the present perfect tense structure is 'has/have + V3 (past participle form of verb)', so 'reviews' should be replaced with 'reviewed'.

Solution (HI):
'Committee' एक collective noun (समूहवाचक संज्ञा) है और जब यह एक इकाई के रूप में कार्य करता है तो इसे एकवचन संज्ञा माना जाता है, इसलिए इसके साथ एकवचन सहायक क्रिया 'has' का उपयोग होता है। साथ ही, present perfect tense की संरचना 'has/have + V3 (past participle)' है, इसलिए 'reviews' को 'reviewed' से बदल दिया जाना चाहिए।

Final Answer: The committee has reviewed the proposal thoroughly.

q_en:
Complete the sentence with the most appropriate option.

Although the sculpture appeared simple at first glance, its design revealed a ____________ complexity upon closer examination.
q_hi:
Complete the sentence with the most appropriate option.

Although the sculpture appeared simple at first glance, its design revealed a ____________ complexity upon closer examination.
solution:
Solution (EN):
The conjunction "Although" indicates a contrast between the two clauses. Since the sculpture "appeared simple at first glance", its complexity upon closer examination must be unexpected or "surprising".

Solution (HI):
Conjunction "Although" दो उपवाक्यों के बीच विरोधाभास (contrast) को दर्शाता है। चूँकि मूर्तिकला "पहली नज़र में सरल दिखाई देती थी", करीब से देखने पर इसकी जटिलता अप्रत्याशित या "surprising" (आश्चर्यजनक) होनी चाहिए।

Final Answer: surprising

Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blanks.

She gave me ____ useful suggestion and ____ honest reply.
q_hi:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blanks.

She gave me ____ useful suggestion and ____ honest reply.
solution:
Solution (EN):
The word 'useful' starts with a consonant sound ('y' sound), so the indefinite article 'a' is used before it. The word 'honest' starts with a vowel sound ('o' sound, as the 'h' is silent), so the indefinite article 'an' is used before it.

Solution (HI):
'Useful' शब्द एक व्यंजन ध्वनि (consonant sound - 'y') से शुरू होता है, इसलिए इसके पहले article 'a' का उपयोग किया जाता है। 'Honest' शब्द एक स्वर ध्वनि (vowel sound - 'o') से शुरू होता है क्योंकि 'h' silent (मौन) है, इसलिए इसके पहले article 'an' का उपयोग किया जाता है।

Final Answer: a, an

q_en:
Complete the following sentence with an appropriate adjective.

Danny is tall, but not ________ than his brother.
q_hi:
Complete the following sentence with an appropriate adjective.

Danny is tall, but not ________ than his brother.
solution:
Solution (EN):
The sentence compares two individuals (Danny and his brother), which requires the comparative degree of the adjective. The comparative form of "tall" is "taller". The presence of the word "than" also clearly indicates a comparison.

Solution (HI):
यह वाक्य दो व्यक्तियों (डैनी और उसके भाई) की तुलना करता है, जिसके लिए विशेषण (adjective) की comparative degree (तुलनात्मक डिग्री) की आवश्यकता होती है। "tall" का comparative रूप "taller" है। वाक्य में "than" शब्द की उपस्थिति भी स्पष्ट रूप से तुलना को दर्शाती है।

Final Answer: taller

q_hi:

solution:
Solution (EN):
The word "eminent" means famous and respected within a particular sphere, which does not fit the context of an expanse of mud. The correct word is "immense", meaning extremely large in scale, proportion, or size, which perfectly describes the expanse of grey mud.

Solution (HI):
"eminent" शब्द का अर्थ प्रसिद्ध और सम्मानित होता है, जो मिट्टी के फैलाव के संदर्भ में उपयुक्त नहीं है। सही शब्द "immense" है, जिसका अर्थ है पैमाने, आकार या अनुपात में बहुत बड़ा (विशाल), जो भूरी मिट्टी के विशाल फैलाव का सही वर्णन करता है।

Final Answer: immense

section: Test of English Language and Comprehension
q_en:
Parts of a sentence are given below in jumbled order. Arrange the parts in the correct order to form a meaningful sentence.
were conducted (A) / in several phases (B) / to ensure accuracy (C) / the experiments (D)
q_hi:
Parts of a sentence are given below in jumbled order. Arrange the parts in the correct order to form a meaningful sentence.
were conducted (A) / in several phases (B) / to ensure accuracy (C) / the experiments (D)
solution:
Solution (EN):
The correct logical order is Subject + Verb + Adverbial phrase + Infinitive phrase. "The experiments" (Subject) + "were conducted" (Verb) + "in several phases" (How) + "to ensure accuracy" (Why). Thus, DABC is the correct sequence.

Solution (HI):
सही तार्किक क्रम है: कर्ता (Subject) + क्रिया (Verb) + क्रियाविशेषण वाक्यांश + अनन्त वाक्यांश। "The experiments" (प्रयोग) + "were conducted" (किए गए) + "in several phases" (कई चरणों में) + "to ensure accuracy" (सटीकता सुनिश्चित करने के लिए)। इस प्रकार, DABC सही क्रम है।

Final Answer: DABC

q_en:
Comprehension:
Read the passage given below and answer the questions that follow.

These days, it’s common to see preteens and teens constantly on their phones, texting or browsing social media. While social media has benefits like connecting people across distances, it also poses risks for today’s youth. Many can’t imagine life without the internet, and by age ten, most kids already have cell phones; nearly 40% have social media accounts by eleven. Teens often crave likes and comments on their posts, comparing themselves to unrealistic standards online. This can lead to body image issues, risky behaviours, and a need for validation. Research shows excessive social media use can cause depression, anxiety, and low self-esteem, while also hindering social and communication skills. Kids spend more time online than interacting in person, missing opportunities to read body language and social cues. It can also affect sleep and academics if technology use goes unchecked. Parents can help by researching popular apps, setting technology-free zones and times, and collecting devices before bed. It’s important to remember that social media is often a highlight reel. Parents should check in with their children regularly and create a supportive environment where kids feel safe sharing their true feelings.
Identify the most suitable title for the passage.

Solution (EN):
The word 'excessive' means more than is necessary, normal, or desirable. Its antonym is 'moderate', which means average in amount, intensity, quality, or degree. 'Abundant', 'Overwhelming', and 'Extreme' are closer to synonyms.
